name: Knoxland Equipment
old_description: Farmers, landscapers, property maintenance, construction contractors, and homeowners have counted on Knoxland Equipment since 1962 to be their one stop shop. We specialize in Mahindra Tractors, LS Tractors, as well as Ferris and Bad Boy Mowers. We also sell respected brands such as Briggs & Stratton, Land Pride, Hiniker, Milwaukee, and RedMax.
about:
Knoxland Equipment has operated from Warner, New Hampshire since 1962. The dealership was established to serve the region's agricultural and property-maintenance customers and has remained a locally owned business for over six decades. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in public records.

The company stocks and sells tractors from Mahindra and LS, zero-turn and walk-behind mowers from Ferris and Bad Boy, and a range of power equipment and attachments from brands including Briggs & Stratton, Land Pride, Hiniker, Milwaukee, and RedMax. A full-service department provides repair and maintenance for all makes and models, handling everything from routine service to major overhauls. The shop also supplies replacement parts and accessories for the brands it carries.

Customers span farming, landscaping, property-maintenance, construction, and residential sectors. The dealership serves commercial contractors, municipal crews, and individual property owners throughout central New Hampshire, offering both equipment sales and ongoing service support.

Knoxland positions itself as a one-stop shop for equipment sales, parts, and service, emphasizing its ability to service any brand regardless of where it was purchased. The company highlights its long-standing presence in the community as a factor in customer retention.
